methodologyNotes: Roster covers twelve handheld consumer/pro-grade sound level (decibel) meters, verified 2026-08-09 against manufacturer/brand product pages (Extech/FLIR, REED Instruments, PCE Instruments, Tenma/Farnell, Galaxy Audio, RISEPRO, UNI-T) where available, corroborated by major retailers and distributors (Home Depot, Cole-Parmer, Transcat, JJS Tech, Sweetwater, Amazon, Walmart, DigiKey, Shopena Supply). One adversarial correction was made to the seed list: the seed "Reed R1900" does not exist as a sound level meter — REED's R1900 model number is a compact air-velocity meter (anemometer), unrelated to acoustic measurement. It was replaced with REED's actual current compact-series sound level meter, the R1920, which a 2026 buyer searching REED's sound-meter lineup would actually find. priceUsd reflects the clearest current retail/manufacturer figure found; where a brand does not publish direct consumer pricing (BAFX, Cadrim, PCE Instruments, Tenma/distributor-quote-only lines), the most consistently cited retailer price is used and priceNote records that. The Extech HD600 is manufacturer-discontinued; its price reflects the last documented retailer listing rather than a current MSRP. Cadrim's USD retail price could not be independently confirmed (its primary listings are on non-US Amazon marketplaces in GBP/EUR/INR) and is left null rather than converted/guessed. accessedAt 2026-08-09 throughout.

products.name: Extech 407730 Digital Sound Level Meter
products.priceNote: Current retail at Transcat/Cole-Parmer; Extech.com does not display consumer pricing (a separate 407730-NIST calibrated version runs ~$309 at Test Equipment Depot)
products.provenance: Extech's own product page confirms 40-130dB range, ±2dB accuracy, 0.1dB resolution, selectable A/C frequency weighting, Fast/Slow time weighting, 0.5in. electret condenser mic, analog bargraph, Max Hold, and 4xAAA battery power. No datalogging is listed on this entry-level model (distinct from the HD600 below). Price $114.00 taken from Transcat/Cole-Parmer as Extech's own site carries no consumer pricing.

products.name: Extech HD600 Datalogging Sound Level Meter (Discontinued)
products.priceNote: Last documented retail at JJS Tech; Extech/FLIR lists this model as discontinued with no current manufacturer MSRP. A NIST-calibrated variant was seen at $752.40 (Test Equipment Depot); an open-box unit sold for $249.97 on eBay.

specs.data_logging: Up to 20,000 records, 1-59 sec logging interval (10 readings/sec via PC connection)

products.provenance: Extech's own (now-discontinued) product page confirms ANSI/IEC 61672-1 Type 2 compliance, 3 ranges spanning 30-130dB at ±1.4dB accuracy, selectable A/C weighting, Fast/Slow response, analog bargraph, Max/Min hold, AC/DC analog outputs, datalogging up to 20,000 records, USB + Windows software, and included tripod/hard case. Dimensions 10.9x3x2in. (278x76x50mm), weight 12.3oz (350g). No current MSRP is published since the model is discontinued; $559.00 (JJS Tech) used as the clearest still-listed retail figure.

products.name: REED Instruments R8050 Dual Range Sound Level Meter
products.priceNote: Current Home Depot retail (a bundled R8050-KIT with acoustic calibrator lists at $485.00)
products.provenance: REED's own product/datasheet pages confirm dual-range measurement (35-100dB low, 65-135dB high), ±1.4dB accuracy, 0.1dB resolution, 31.5Hz-8kHz frequency range, A&C weighting, Fast/Slow time weighting, 1/2in. electret condenser mic, 9V battery power, backlit LCD, and built-in tripod mount. No datalogging function is documented for the base R8050 (distinct from logging-capable REED models). Meets ANSI/IEC Type 2. Price $160.00 per Home Depot.

products.name: BAFX Products Advanced Decibel Meter / Sound Level Reader
products.priceNote: Manufacturer direct price on bafxpro.com (listed as sold out at time of check); the simpler "Standard" BAFX model (30-130dBA, ±2.0dB, no datalogging) sells separately on Amazon at a lower price point

specs.data_logging: Stores up to 4,700 data points via USB with included Soundlab software (Windows only)

products.provenance: BAFX Products' own store page confirms the Advanced model's 30-130dBA/35-130dBC range, ±1.5dBA accuracy, selectable Fast(125ms)/Slow(1s) time weighting, 31.5Hz-8.5kHz frequency response, 4,700-point USB datalogging with bundled Windows software, Max hold, 10-minute auto shutoff, and 1-year warranty; this is the seed's "BAFX Products SPL Meter" entry, distinguished from BAFX's separate lower-cost Standard-range meter (30-130dB, ±2.0dB, no logging) sold on Amazon. No numeric resolution figure (e.g., 0.1dB) is stated on any fetched BAFX source, so resolution_db is left null rather than assumed by analogy to similarly-priced competitors. $54.99 is BAFX's own direct price, though the unit shows sold-out status there.

products.name: PCE Instruments PCE-322A Data Logging Sound Level Meter
products.priceNote: Current US authorized-reseller price (Shopena Supply, 10% off $295.00 list); Radwell lists $323.00 new / $194-246 refurbished/repackaged. PCE Instruments' own US site returned a 403 on direct fetch, so its listed price could not be independently confirmed.

specs.data_logging: Stores up to 32,700 readings, sampling 2x/sec, USB transfer to PC/Excel

products.provenance: DigiKey's product-highlight page (reproducing PCE Instruments' own manufacturer spec sheet) confirms 30-130dB range at ±1.4dB accuracy, 0.1dB resolution, A/C frequency weighting, Fast(125ms)/Slow(1s) time weighting, electret condenser mic, IEC 61672-1 Class II compliance, and datalogging up to 32,700 readings at 2 samples/sec via USB with Excel-compatible export. Shopena Supply (authorized US reseller) corroborates identical specs and states the current $265.50 price (10% off $295.00 list). PCE Instruments' own pce-instruments.com pages returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch, so DigiKey's syndicated spec sheet and an authorized reseller were used instead; no verifiable freely-licensed or directly manufacturer-hosted product image could be retrieved within available access, so the image field is omitted rather than guessed.

products.name: REED Instruments R1920 Compact Sound Level Meter
products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: the seed model "Reed R1900" is not a sound level meter — REED's actual R1900 is a compact air-velocity meter (anemometer) that measures airflow in fpm/m/s/mph, per REED's own product catalog. It was replaced with REED's genuine compact-series sound level meter, the R1920 (REED's own page and every fetched retailer confirm this as the sound-measuring model in that product line a buyer would actually find). REED's page confirms 30-130dB range at ±1.5dB accuracy, 0.1dB resolution, 31.5Hz-8kHz frequency range with A weighting, Fast/Slow time weighting, 0.5in. electret condenser mic, 4-digit backlit LCD, data hold/min/max, and (3) AAA battery power. No datalogging function is documented. Dimensions 5.9x2x1.1in. (150x52x27mm), weight 4.1oz (116g). Price $79.00 per Microdaq.

products.name: Tenma 72-947 Digital Sound Level Meter with USB Interface and Datalogging
products.priceNote: Current Amazon retail; Farnell/Newark/CPC list the SKU but display quote-only pricing rather than a posted figure

specs.data_logging: Internal datalogging up to 20,000 records; USB interface with Windows datalogging software

products.provenance: Tenma's official Farnell-hosted datasheet confirms 30-130dB range at 31.5Hz-8kHz, ±1.4dB accuracy at 1kHz/94dB reference, 0.1dB resolution on a 1999-count backlit LCD, removable 1/2in. electret condenser mic and windscreen, 125ms fast/1s slow time weighting, A/C frequency weighting, internal datalogging up to 20,000 records plus USB interface with PC software, AC/DC analog outputs, self-calibration via internal oscillator, and 9V battery power, IEC61672-1 Class 2 compliant. Price $231.92 on Amazon; UK distributors (Farnell, Newark, CPC) list the part but require a quote request rather than displaying a fixed price.

products.name: Galaxy Audio CM-140 Check Mate SPL Meter

specs.measurement_range_db: Lo 32-80 dB, Med 50-100 dB, Hi 80-130 dB

products.provenance: Galaxy Audio's own product page and instruction manual confirm IEC 651/ANSI S1.4 Type 2 compliance, three ranges (32-80/50-100/80-130dB) with a 50dB dynamic span each, ±1.5dB accuracy, 4-digit 0.1dB-resolution LCD updating every 0.5s, 31.5Hz-8kHz frequency range, MAX/MIN hold, AC signal output (1Vrms full scale), electret condenser mic, windscreen included, and up to 70 hours runtime on one 9V battery. No datalogging/memory function is documented — this is a live-reading SPL meter aimed at live-sound/church-audio use, not an industrial data logger. Price $142.01 at Sweetwater.

products.name: Dr.meter MS10 Digital Decibel Sound Level Meter Tester
products.priceNote: Representative current online retail price; this budget model has historically sold anywhere from ~$11-$30 across flash sales and marketplace listings, so figure should be treated as approximate
products.provenance: Retailer/reviewer listings (reproducing Dr.meter's own packaging copy) consistently document a 30-130dBA range, ±1.5dB accuracy, 0.1dBA resolution, 1/2in. electret condenser mic with wind-noise reduction, 31.5Hz-8kHz frequency response, MAX/MIN hold, 9V battery with ~50hr runtime, 15-minute auto shutoff, and IEC 651/ANSI S1.4 Type 2 compliance. No fast/slow time-weighting selector is documented on this entry-level model, so time_weighting is left null rather than assumed. No datalogging/memory function is documented. Because this is a long-running budget SKU with no manufacturer-published MSRP and highly volatile marketplace pricing ($11.99-$30 seen across years), $25.99 is used as a representative current figure with the volatility flagged in priceNote rather than treated as authoritative.

products.name: RISEPRO HT-80A Digital Decibel Sound Level Meter
products.provenance: Amazon/Walmart listing copy (reproducing RISEPRO's own packaging specs) confirms 30-130dB dual-range measurement, ±1.5dB accuracy, 0.1dB resolution on a 3-digit LCD, 31.5Hz-4kHz stated frequency range, Type A frequency weighting, 125ms fast time weighting only (no slow mode documented), Data Hold/Max/Min, backlight, auto power off, and single 9V battery power. Dimensions ~170x58x35mm, weight ~107g. No datalogging/memory function is documented on this consumer-grade unit. Price $35.00 at Walmart.

products.name: UNI-T UT353 Mini Sound Level Meter
products.priceNote: Current Amazon retail (non-Bluetooth base model); the Bluetooth-enabled UT353BT sibling lists higher, around $51
products.provenance: UNI-T's own product page confirms 30-130dB range at ±1.5dB accuracy, 0.1dB resolution, 31.5Hz-8kHz frequency range, fast(125ms)/slow(1000ms) time weighting, 1/2in. condenser mic, LCD backlight, data hold, MAX/MIN tracking, overload indication, 15-minute auto power off, and 3xAAA battery power; meets IEC 651/ANSI S1.4 Type 2. This base UT353 has no datalogging or wireless transfer, distinguishing it from the Bluetooth UT353BT variant which adds smartphone-app data logging. Price $25.99 on Amazon for the base model.
